The '''Maires system''' was located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]], in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Maires/Legends|Maires]].
